comparison.objective: Add a personal padlock through a free group-lockout hasp hole without disturbing a coworker’s lock or enabling the switch.
comparison.physical_skill: Align and insert a shackle through two hasp jaws, close its latch, and avoid disturbing an existing safety assembly.
comparison.success_condition: Full credit requires the closed lock to withstand hasp-pry and handle-on tests after release; moving the coworker’s lock or opening/turning the mechanism early causes irrevocable zero.
comparison.reason: Shackle insertion and safety interlocking do not involve threaded calibration, reaction counterholding, or verification of a retained angular stop.
